sources.title: The F-theory geometry with most flux vacua

evidence.text: Could one elliptic Calabi–Yau fourfold dominate the statistical count of four-dimensional F-theory flux vacua, and thereby constrain likely gauge sectors and realizations of the standard model?

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Does the proposed smooth-base F-theory rank bound survive further tests, and can admissible base geometry yield a universal rank bound?

sources.title: A Picard rank bound for base surfaces of elliptic Calabi-Yau 3-folds

evidence.text: Can one compute a concrete uniform upper bound on the Picard rank of compact surfaces serving as bases of elliptic Calabi–Yau threefolds, and identify geometric mechanisms behind that boundedness?

sources.title: A Finiteness theorem for elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Are elliptically fibred algebraic Calabi–Yau threefolds covered, up to birational equivalence, by finitely many families? The principal theorem treats rational bases; finiteness of topological types is a separate question.

sources.title: The F-theory geometry with most flux vacua

evidence.text: A finite scan of toric B2 bundles over P1 restricts twists through monomial inequalities excluding forbidden singularities, then estimates h3,1 using monomial counts and dual-polytope face corrections.

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: Substitute the full axionic redefinition into gauge and curvature coefficients; separately compare its saxionic partner with the printed expression.

sources.title: A Picard rank bound for base surfaces of elliptic Calabi-Yau 3-folds

evidence.text: Represent exceptional curves by rooted trees. Single-type blowups occur on one fiber component and double-type blowups at two-component intersections. Bound clusters using horizontal multiplicities, special-fiber coefficient caps, and a correspondence between vertical intersection points and exceptional curves.

sources.title: A Finiteness theorem for elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Ogg–Shafarevich theory and local cohomology encode genus-one torsors. Negative definite intersection matrices bound allowable multiple-fibre invariants; constructibility, torsion bounds, étale covers and Noetherian induction turn fibrewise finiteness into finitely many families.

sources.title: The F-theory geometry with most flux vacua

evidence.text: Toric lattice-point enumeration determines Weierstrass monomials, divisor vanishing orders and generic non-Higgsable factors. Counting monomials with an automorphism correction reproduces the stated complex-structure Hodge number.

sources.title: The F-theory geometry with most flux vacua

evidence.text: The imported Ashok–Denef–Douglas estimation framework is implemented through lattice points in a b4-dimensional sphere of radius √(2Q), using a Jacobi-theta generating function, contour integral and large-dimension saddle point.

sources.title: Discrete Gauge Groups in F-theory Models on Genus-One Fibered Calabi-Yau 4-folds without Section

evidence.text: Which discrete gauge symmetries arise in the paper's examples of F-theory compactification on genus-one fibered Calabi–Yau fourfolds without a section, and can their multisection degrees be obtained uniformly from intersection theory?

sources.title: Elliptic Calabi-Yau fivefolds and 2d (0,2) F-theory landscape

evidence.text: Which compact elliptic Calabi-Yau fivefolds realize the largest known geometric field contents in 2d (0,2) F-theory, and how does gravitational anomaly cancellation constrain examples with smooth or singular fourfold bases?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Which fixed compactification bases force a gauge sector at generic complex structure? Hirzebruch surfaces give explicit examples where coordinate charges restrict the allowed Weierstrass sections.

sources.title: Classifying fibers and bases in toric hypersurface Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Classify the toric elliptic and genus-one fibrations in the Kreuzer–Skarke database, identify their fibers and bases modulo ambient-polytope automorphisms, and interpret ordinary and exotic examples through 6D F-theory.

sources.title: Special Geometry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a Picard-one Calabi–Yau threefold avoid rational curves? The section tests that assumption through a one-modulus cubic geometry and a genus-one topological index, because the projective intersection-hypersurface argument is unavailable.

sources.title: Compactifications of F theory on Calabi-Yau threefolds. 1

evidence.text: Which heterotic/Type-II dualities lift to six-dimensional heterotic/F-theory dualities, how can the dual elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds be constructed, and what geometry represents heterotic strong coupling and strong/weak self-duality?

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Can nongeometric phases enlarge the geometric F-theory classification? Discrete torsion can freeze smoothing moduli and alter gauge algebras, with frozen I*n fibers interpreted through O7+ planes.

sources.title: Exotic matter on singular divisors in F-theory

evidence.text: Do the F-theory restrictions reflect general quantum-consistency conditions or only this construction framework? Outstanding tasks include global tuning completeness, independent-modulus counts after redundancy removal, and supersymmetric realizations of other anomaly-consistent exotic spectra.

sources.title: Modular Curves and Mordell-Weil Torsion in F-theory

evidence.text: Which Mordell-Weil torsion groups occur on smooth elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau varieties, and what restrictions follow for non-simply connected F-theory gauge groups and certain quotient torsors?

sources.title: Generating functions for intersection products of divisors in resolved F-theory models

evidence.text: How can divisor intersection numbers in resolved elliptic F-theory geometries be computed efficiently enough to access large-rank gauge groups?

sources.title: An infinite swampland of U(1) charge spectra in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Can low-energy consistency explain the finite F-theory spectrum set, its divisor inequalities, and the distinction between standard and exotic geometric constructions? The source also asks how added nonabelian sectors and charged-string worldvolume physics modify the constraints.

sources.title: $\tfrac{1}{2}$Calabi–Yau $4$-folds and four-dimensional F-theory on Calabi–Yau $4$-folds with $\mathrm{U}(1)$ factors

evidence.text: How can rational elliptic fourfolds and their double covers systematically generate four-dimensional N = 1 F-theory geometries with multiple section-derived U(1) factors, and can base geometry indicate compatible K3 fibrations and heterotic duals?

sources.title: GV-Spectroscopy for F-theory on genus-one fibrations

evidence.text: How can base-independent matter-locus classes and F-theory spectra be extracted efficiently from generic toric complete-intersection fibers, including fibers with multisections, and used to analyze Higgs chains ending in Z4 vacua?

sources.title: General F-theory models with tuned $(\operatorname{SU}(3) \times \operatorname{SU}(2) \times \operatorname{U}(1)) / \mathbb{Z}_6$ symmetry

evidence.text: Can an explicit parameterized Weierstrass construction realize the directly tuned Standard Model quotient gauge group with generic matter, and capture all allowed moduli for fixed gauge and divisor data?

sources.title: Machine Learning in the String Landscape

evidence.text: Can interpretable supervised learning accelerate exploration of F-theory geometries and generate provable conjectures about triangulation counts, gauge-group rank, and the occurrence of E6 sectors?

sources.title: Large U(1) charges in F-theory

evidence.text: Determine the largest massless charge in six-dimensional F-theory with one U(1) factor, accounting for charge normalization and spectator gauge symmetry. Anomaly cancellation permits apparently unlimited spectra, while the source invokes geometric finiteness to motivate an upper bound.

sources.title: Extremal $1/2$ Calabi–Yau $3$-folds and six-dimensional F-theory applications

evidence.text: How can projective duality classify maximal-rank singularities of rational elliptic 1/2 Calabi–Yau threefolds, expose their fibers and sections, and determine geometric inputs for six-dimensional N=1 F-theory on their double covers?

sources.title: F theory on Calabi-Yau fourfolds

evidence.text: Can an explicit generalized twist construction turn lower-dimensional duality expectations into testable cohomology predictions for four-dimensional F-theory on elliptically fibered Calabi–Yau fourfolds?

sources.title: Elliptic K3 surfaces at infinite complex structure and their refined Kulikov models

evidence.text: How can infinite-distance complex-structure degenerations of elliptic K3 surfaces be classified through canonical Weierstrass models, and how does this geometry support their F-theory interpretation?

sources.title: Singularities of $1/2$ Calabi–Yau 4-folds and classification scheme for gauge groups in four-dimensional F-theory

evidence.text: How can one classify ADE singularities of rational elliptic fourfold building blocks and their Calabi–Yau double covers, recover their defining hypersurfaces from a prescribed singularity type, and extract geometric gauge-sector information for 4D N = 1 F-theory?

sources.title: $\mathbb{P}^1$-fibrations in F-theory and string dualities

evidence.text: How do general P¹-bundles and degenerating P¹-fibrations enlarge F-theory base geometries, and how do base transitions, rational sections and fiber monodromy modify heterotic/F-theory duality?

sources.title: Constraints on Standard Model Constructions in F-theory

evidence.text: Can F-theory Standard Model constructions simultaneously have realistic UV gauge couplings, moderate-to-large h^{1,1}, control through the supergravity approximation, and no additional seven-brane gauge sectors?

sources.title: Enhanced gauge symmetry in 6D F-theory models and tuned elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Which gauge and matter enhancements can be tuned over a fixed F-theory base, how closely do geometric constructions match anomaly-consistent unHiggsings, and can their Hodge shifts organize a finite classification?

sources.title: $ \frac{1}{2} $ Calabi-Yau 3-folds, Calabi-Yau 3-folds as double covers, and F-theory with U(1)s

evidence.text: Can double covers of rational elliptic threefolds systematically construct elliptically fibered Calabi–Yau threefolds with positive Mordell–Weil rank, yielding six-dimensional N=1 F-theory models with multiple U(1) factors?

sources.title: Calabi-Yau fourfolds for M theory and F theory compactifications

evidence.text: Which explicit Calabi-Yau fourfold deformation families support M- and F-theory compactifications, and how do their topology, instanton divisors, elliptic degenerations, transitions and quantum cohomology encode effective-theory properties?

evidence.text: Decompose δ using the first real splitting, evaluate the weight-three polynomial, and act on the filtration. A lone component of bidegree (−3,−3) produces no ζ correction.

evidence.text: Map bulk charges to probe theories, justify equal-sector connectivity, reconstruct global moduli geometry from local data, and impose its finite budget. sources.title: Anomalies as obstructions: from dimensional lifts to swampland

evidence.text: Match a fixed physical smearing scale to the proper distance in the Taub-NUT metric, then demand that the source's coordinate support vanish. The resulting large integer-charge condition specifies the source's proposed regime of inflow control.

sources.title: Swampland cobordism conjecture and non-Abelian duality groups

evidence.text: How does a duality-twisted circle acquire a physical source when capped? In the F-theory description, a nontrivial torus automorphism around the circle becomes a singular elliptic fiber at the cap.

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: Do lower-dimensional theories with eight supercharges possess an analogue of automatic enhancement beyond compactified elliptic examples? The absence of pure U(1)-charged Higgs fields motivates this question, but a universal constraint on general Calabi–Yau threefolds is not derived.

sources.title: GUTs and Exceptional Branes in F-theory - II: Experimental Predictions

evidence.text: How can six-dimensional F-theory spectra on freely acting, fibration-preserving quotients of elliptic Calabi–Yau threefolds be determined from the covering geometry and its symmetry action, including discrete gauge symmetries and strongly coupled sectors?

sources.title: Fine Tuning, Sequestering, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which six-dimensional N = (1,0) local conformal sectors fit into compact models with dynamical gravity? F-theory represents the problem using elliptic threefolds, curve collapses in their bases, and finite geometric deformation spaces.

sources.title: The desert and the swampland

evidence.text: Which protected objects can constrain the gap of six-dimensional F-theory vacua? Wrapped D3 strings are accessible through the tensor sector even though KK modes, generic string excitations, and charged-particle masses are not reliably computable.

evidence.text: What replaces ordinary bifundamental matter between ADE gauge factors, and how can its tensor branches, partial Higgs branches, circle reductions and wall counterparts be characterized?

evidence.text: This resolved orientifold provides an explicit F-theory geometry in which wrapped-D3 string flows can be compared with KK towers. Movable and exceptional divisors permit both simple charge rays and more general rays whose volumes depend on the resolution chamber.
